title: Explicit String Vacua and the Geometric Selection Conjecture: research manuscript, source and construction checks
description:
Research revision by Deep Bhattacharjee and Ushashi Bhattacharya. Annals-format and Hexagon-format manuscripts have the same mathematical body. The archive includes a marked-point selection-functional construction, independent Chern/slope/index checks of a published tetraquadric example, a free invariant-family construction, matter-normalization bounds, a quantitative stability criterion, and a local global-supersymmetry effective model with its missing string realization stated explicitly.

The full Geometric Selection Conjecture remains unproved. No single heterotic vacuum satisfying all nine viability conditions is constructed. The local effective potential is not derived from the compactification; projected spectra, physical masses, stabilization and supersymmetry breaking still require the recorded joint certificates. No Annals-level novelty or acceptance is claimed.

The package includes exact Python controls, symbolic Sympy checks, compilation and visual-review records, AI provenance and a proof-status ledger. The geometric model is credited to Buchbinder, Constantin and Lukas, JHEP 03 (2014) 025. Earlier sources are cited for formulation and provenance; no unrefereed existence theorem supplies a viable vacuum. The v1 note is retained for context. New author review remains pending. GitHub/Zenodo publication does not constitute a Hexagon v2 upload or journal submission.
